title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Food and Drug Disputes

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a consumer brings a civil action concerning a dispute over food or drugs, and the conditions for acceptance prescribed in the Civil Procedure Law are satisfied, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 2 Where a consumer suffers damage due to quality issues of food or drugs, the consumer may separately sue or simultaneously sue the seller and the producer.
If the consumer only sues the seller or the producer, the People's Court may, when necessary, add the relevant parties to participate in the proceedings.

Article 3 Where a dispute arises due to quality issues of food or drugs, and the purchaser claims rights against the producer or seller, and the producer or seller defends on the ground that the purchaser knew of the quality issues yet still purchased, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 4 Where a quality safety issue arises with a food or drug product provided as a gift by the producer or seller to the consumer, causing damage to the consumer, and the consumer claims rights, and the producer or seller defends for exemption on the ground that the consumer did not pay consideration for the gift, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 5 Where a consumer adduces evidence to prove the fact of purchasing food or drugs and that the purchased food or drugs do not conform to the contract, and claims that the producer or seller of the food or drugs bears liability for breach of contract, the People's Court shall uphold such claim.
Where a consumer adduces evidence to prove that he or she has suffered damage due to consumption of food or use of drugs, and makes a preliminary showing that there is a causal relationship between the damage and the consumption of food or use of drugs, and requests the producer or seller of the food or drugs to bear tort liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request, except where the producer or seller can prove that the damage is not caused by the product's non-conformity with quality standards.

Article 6 The producer and seller of food shall bear the burden of adducing evidence that the food conforms to quality standards. Whether food is safe shall be determined based on national standards; for local specialty food, where there are no national standards, it shall be determined based on local standards. Where there are no such standards, it shall be determined based on the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law.

Article 7 Although food or drugs have obtained inspection certificates before sale, and are still within the shelf life at the time of consumption or use, if upon inspection the product is confirmed to be defective, and the producer or seller defends on the ground that the food or drug has an inspection certificate, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 8 Where the organizer of a centralized trading market, the lessor of counters, or the sponsor of an exhibition fails to perform the obligations of examination, inspection, reporting, etc., as provided for in the Food Safety Law, thereby harming the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and the consumer requests that the organizer, lessor, or sponsor bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 9 Where a consumer suffers damage from purchasing food or drugs through a third-party online trading platform, and the provider of the third-party online trading platform is unable to provide the true name, address, and effective contact information of the producer or seller of the food or drugs, and the consumer requests the platform provider to bear liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
After the third-party online trading platform provider bears compensation liability, it shall have a right of recourse against the producer or seller, and the People's Court shall uphold such recourse.
Where the provider of the third-party online trading platform knew or should have known that the producer or seller of food or drugs is using its platform to infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and fails to take necessary measures, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests that it bear joint and several liability with the producer and seller, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 10 Where a civil subject that has not obtained the qualifications for food production and sales affiliates itself with a producer or seller that has the corresponding qualifications to produce and sell food, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests that the affiliate and the affiliated entity bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
If the consumer only sues the affiliate or the affiliated entity, the People's Court may, when necessary, add the relevant parties to participate in the proceedings.

Article 11 Where a consumer suffers damage due to quality issues of food or drugs recommended in false advertisements, and requests the advertising operator and advertising publisher to bear joint and several liability in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where another civil subject recommends food or drugs to consumers in false advertisements, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests that such subject bear joint and several liability together with the producer or seller of the food or drugs in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 12 Where a food or drug inspection institution intentionally issues a false inspection report, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests it to bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where a food or drug inspection institution negligently issues an untrue inspection report, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests it to bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 13 Where a food certification institution intentionally issues a false certification, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests it to bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where a food certification institution negligently issues an untrue certification, causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests it to bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 14 Where food or drugs produced or sold have quality issues, and the producer and seller need to simultaneously bear civil liability, administrative liability, and criminal liability, but their property is insufficient to pay, and the party requests, in accordance with the Civil Code and other relevant laws, that the producer or seller of the food or drugs bear civil liability first, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 15 Where a person produces food that does not conform to safety standards or sells food knowing that it does not conform to safety standards, and the consumer, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, claims punitive damages from the producer or seller in accordance with the Food Safety Law and other legal provisions, the People's Court shall uphold such claim.
Where a person produces fake or substandard drugs, or sells or uses fake or substandard drugs knowing them to be such, and the victim or his or her close relatives, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, claims punitive damages from the producer or seller in accordance with the Drug Administration Law and other legal provisions, the People's Court shall uphold such claim.

Article 16 Where the producer or seller of food or drugs, by means of standard form contracts, notices, declarations, announcements, or other means, makes provisions that exclude or limit consumers' rights, reduce or exempt the operator's liability, increase consumers' liability, or are otherwise unfair or unreasonable to consumers, and the consumer requests, according to law, that such content be deemed invalid, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 17 Disputes between consumers and producers, sellers, advertising operators, advertising publishers, recommenders, inspection institutions, or other entities of products such as cosmetics and health foods shall be handled by reference to these Provisions.
Where an organ prescribed by law or a relevant organization brings a public interest litigation according to law, these Provisions shall be applied by reference.

Article 18 "Producer of drugs" as used in these Provisions includes the drug marketing authorization holder and drug manufacturing enterprise, and "seller of drugs" includes drug distribution enterprises and medical institutions.

Article 19 These Provisions shall apply to cases of first instance and second instance that are being tried by the People's Courts after these Provisions come into force.
These Provisions shall not apply to cases that have been finally adjudicated before these Provisions come into force, and for which a party applies for retrial after these Provisions come into force or which are decided to be retried in accordance with the procedure for trial supervision.
